changelog: Fully interactive Doppler Radar map with mouse pan, cursor zoom, GTA coordinates readout, and floating controls.
Click-to-spawn dynamic temporary localized storm cells with custom weather, radius, and duration on Doppler radar.
Regional Climate Selector in Weather tab allowing independent weather assignment to South, Central, or North regions.
Complete flight turbulence physics softening and rate-limiting with in-game toggle for silky-smooth aircraft handling.
Quick Tri-Regional mode toggle button and live regional meteorological telemetry badges.
